invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieData instance constructed from eager update, so result should never be null.
The return value must be of type HoodieData, consistent with the declared return type.
writeStatuses is used as an argument, so must not be null at method exit.
context is passed to other functions, so must not be null at method exit.
hoodieTable is passed to other functions, so should not be null at method exit.
